semiconductor_relevance: High — Wisely Gobal Solutions specializes in ultrapure fluid handling systems critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Wisely Gobal Solutions Pte Ltd (WGS) provides advanced ultrapure fluid handling systems essential for maintaining cleanliness and flow stability in semiconductor manufacturing. Their flagship Levitronix® maglev pump technology offers innovative solutions for precise fluid control in cleanroom environments.

regional_presence.Singapore: WGS is headquartered in Singapore and has been an authorized representative of Levitronix® for 20 years.
regional_presence.India: WGS has established a support office in Chennai, India.
